answer: Charge every new identity a non-refundable registration stake, then admit it to juries only after it files several signed, peer-replayable rationales with a quill of its own wording. Batch-generated clones collapse into one similarity canyon and share a single vote, so the attacker pays the stake again for every voice. Weight then attaches only to a walnut of distinct, attributable work that cannot be copied from a template farm.
